reason: Three methodologically critical simplifications identified in review (2026-07-16). The result remains a strong mechanistic prototype but is NOT a general proof of autonomous adaptive compute.
target_privilege_detail: controller regresses need_score to (direct_loss - sem_loss), computed with the ground-truth canonical target and by running BOTH paths. This is counterfactual value distillation (R3-B), not fully end-to-end task-loss routing (R3-C).
test_capacity_detail: eval_cap = int((vkind == HARD_SEMANTIC).sum()) — ground-truth task labels indirectly set test-time semantic capacity.
surface_cues_detail: EASY/HARD differ by explicit markers (flag tokens, NOT, F_DIST, F_IS) and by length/first-token; the controller may classify FORMAT rather than estimate mechanism need.
physical_compute_detail: TypedCognitiveGraph.forward runs BOTH paths and selects by mask -> routing does not save forward compute; 'compute-saving router' wording is PROHIBITED until sparse dispatch is implemented.
artifact_status: FROZEN, not deleted. Superseded by Routing v3 (end-to-end R3-C, fixed pre-eval capacity, surface-matched pairs, real sparse execution) when built.
